items_flat.title_en: Anthropic amended S-1 reveals ~$17B Q3 revenue and $895B compute commitments
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic修訂S-1揭露第三季約170億美元營收與8950億美元算力承諾
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic filed an amended Form S-1/A on November 2 disclosing Q3 2026 revenue of $16.96 billion (up 1,127% year-over-year and 47% quarter-over-quarter). It swung to a $567 million operating loss, mainly from higher-cost short-term compute, while total compute commitments reached approximately $895 billion.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月2日提交修訂版S-1/A，揭露2026年第三季營收169.6億美元（年增1,127%、季增47%）。公司轉為5.67億美元營運虧損，主要因較高成本的短期算力，總算力承諾約達8950億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The filing quantifies the capital intensity of frontier AI scaling and shows sequential growth already decelerating while absolute compute obligations remain enormous. IPO investors will weigh growth against these multi-year commitments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文件量化前沿AI擴張的資本密集程度，顯示季成長已開始放緩，但絕對算力義務仍極龐大。IPO投資人將權衡成長與這些多年承諾。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shows ChatGPT and Codex accelerating physical engineering and hardware design
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI展示ChatGPT與Codex加速實體工程與硬體設計
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a research post on November 3 describing how ChatGPT and Codex help engineers with CAD, PCB design, simulation, and manufacturing drawings. Internal hardware team token use grew 23-fold since February; a side project used GPT-6 Astra to design a Codex-talking device in under a week. The lab is collaborating with Chip Ganassi Racing and Mazda.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月3日發布研究貼文，說明ChatGPT與Codex如何協助工程師進行CAD、PCB設計、模擬與製造圖。內部硬體團隊自二月以來的token使用量成長23倍；一項附屬專案用GPT-6 Astra在一週內設計出可與Codex對話的裝置。實驗室正與Chip Ganassi Racing及Mazda合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extending agentic coding tools into hardware shortens digital iteration but does not remove physical constraints such as tolerances, compliance, or manufacturing. Early internal gains are real; external reliability still depends on human review.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將代理編碼工具延伸至硬體可縮短數位迭代，但無法消除公差、法規與製造等實體限制。內部早期成果確實存在，外部可靠性仍仰賴人工審核。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們分享OpenAI模型如何協助工程師設計、模擬與建造實體產品的進展。

items_flat.title_en: Google releases Physical-Engineering’s Last Exam (PLE) agent benchmark and open competition
items_flat.title_zh: Google發布實體工程最終考試（PLE）代理基準與公開競賽
items_flat.summary_en: On November 3 Google AI & Infrastructure announced PLE, an 85-task benchmark of long-horizon mechanical, electrical, civil and structural engineering work developed with Mercor. It released 29 public tasks, graders and a leaderboard; on the private set the best model (Claude Opus 5.5) scored 48.3%, with all frontier models below 50%.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月3日Google AI與基礎設施團隊宣布PLE，這是與Mercor合作開發的85項長期機械、電機、土木與結構工程任務基準。釋出29項公開任務、評分工具與排行榜；私有測試集上最佳模型（Claude Opus 5.5）得分48.3%，所有前沿模型皆低於50%。
items_flat.analysis_en: PLE exposes a clear gap between strong coding-agent scores and the ability to produce fully code-compliant, cost-aware physical designs. Hard safety gates mean partial correctness rarely earns full credit.
items_flat.analysis_zh: PLE揭示強大編碼代理分數與產出完全符合法規、考量成本的實體設計能力之間的明顯落差。嚴格安全關卡使部分正確很少獲得完整分數。
items_flat.quote: Today, the Google AI & Infrastructure team is announcing Physical-Engineering's Last Exam (PLE), a new benchmark and open competition.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Google AI與基礎設施團隊宣布實體工程最終考試（PLE），一項新的基準與公開競賽。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for cryptographic proof of LLM inference
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開源FlashProve，以加密方式證明LLM推論來源
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team published on November 2 and highlighted on X on November 3 FlashProve, an open-source zkSNARK prototype that lets a provider commit to model weights and prove a response came from that model without revealing the weights. On Llama 4 Maverick (400B, 4-bit) a single H100 generates proofs at ~110 tokens/s with ~19 MB proofs per 1,024-token request.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊於11月2日發布、並於11月3日在X上強調FlashProve，這是開源zkSNARK原型，讓供應商承諾模型權重並證明回應來自該模型而不揭露權重。在Llama 4 Maverick（400B、4-bit）上，單一H100以約110 tokens/秒產生證明，每1,024 token請求約19 MB。
items_flat.analysis_en: Provable inference addresses real trust gaps in routing, evaluation and server compromise, but the 70–95× proving overhead versus vLLM keeps it a research prototype rather than a production feature today.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可證明推論解決路由、評估與伺服器遭入侵等真實信任落差，但相較vLLM約70–95倍的證明開銷，使其目前仍屬研究原型而非生產功能。
items_flat.quote: Today, we release FlashProve: an open-source performant prototype for provable inference.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們發布FlashProve：一個開源、高效能的可證明推論原型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces Pando, a Git-compatible backend scaled for Codex-driven monorepo work
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Pando，為Codex驅動的單一儲存庫工作擴展的Git相容後端
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an engineering post on November 2 describing Pando, a new Git-compatible backend that now powers its monorepo. Built in roughly 10 weeks with heavy Codex agent assistance, it supports concurrent pushes across branches, reuses existing Git clients, and cut median push latency nearly 5× while serving nearly a petabyte of Git data daily.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日發布工程貼文，介紹Pando，現已驅動其單一儲存庫的新Git相容後端。在約10週內大量借助Codex代理協助建置，支援跨分支並發推送、重用既有Git客戶端，並將中位數推送延遲降低近5倍，每日處理近1 PB的Git資料。
items_flat.analysis_en: Agentic coding has shifted the bottleneck from model capability to surrounding infrastructure such as source control. Pando shows one lab treating that infrastructure as first-class and shipping it with the same agents that created the load.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 代理編碼已將瓶頸從模型能力移至原始碼控制等周邊基礎設施。Pando顯示實驗室將此基礎設施視為一級公民，並用產生負載的同一批代理來交付。
items_flat.quote: We built Pando, a new backend for Git repositories, without interrupting any engineering work or changing how our team uses Git. Pando now powers all development in OpenAI’s monorepo.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們打造了 Pando，一個新的 Git 儲存庫後端，過程中未中斷任何工程工作，也未改變團隊使用 Git 的方式。Pando 現在驅動 OpenAI monorepo 的所有開發。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1T-parameter Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral釋出1T參數Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開放權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a roughly 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model, on October 29 under a modified MIT-style license. After additional reinforcement learning it leads open models on coding-agent and cyber benchmarks while using substantially fewer tokens than comparables.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral於10月29日釋出改良版Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開放權重，這是約1兆參數的原生多模態混合專家模型，採修改版MIT式授權。經額外強化學習後，在編碼代理與網路安全基準上領先開放模型，且使用的token明顯少於同類。
items_flat.analysis_en: A European lab shipping a trillion-parameter open-weight model with strong coding and cyber results lowers the barrier for sovereign or on-premise frontier-class agents. Token efficiency remains the practical differentiator versus closed alternatives.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 歐洲實驗室推出具強編碼與網路安全表現的兆參數開放權重模型，降低主權或本地部署前沿級代理的門檻。相較封閉替代方案，token效率仍是實際差異點。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出這個改進版 Mistral Large 4 的權重。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes LifeVal, an evaluation of everyday personal-assistant tasks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發布LifeVal，評估日常個人助理任務
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released LifeVal on November 2, a benchmark of practical everyday tasks (childcare, health, household administration, finances, shopping, government services) shaped by time-use studies and a survey of nearly 4,000 people. On OpenAI’s latest models many tasks now score above 90%.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日發布LifeVal，這是涵蓋托兒、健康、家庭行政、財務、購物與政府服務等實用日常任務的基準，由時間使用研究與近4,000人調查塑造。在OpenAI最新模型上，許多任務得分已超過90%。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving evaluation beyond coding and exams toward multi-step real-world errands is directionally useful for personal agents, but the benchmark is internal and self-scored, so independent replication remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將評估從編碼與考試移向多步驟現實雜務，對個人代理方向有用，但基準為內部自評，獨立複現仍有限。
items_flat.quote: For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal...
items_flat.quote_zh: 為了讓 AGI 惠及全人類，它應幫助人們處理最重要的日常任務。因此我們打造了 LifeVal……

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands invisible text watermark to Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將隱形文字浮水印擴展至Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6
items_flat.summary_en: Effective November 3, text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s invisible text watermark (an imperceptible pattern in word choice). On Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 the mark applies only at default sampling settings; Bedrock rollout may lag a few days.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自11月3日起，Claude Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6產生的文字將帶有Anthropic的隱形文字浮水印（詞彙選擇中的不可察覺模式）。在Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6上，僅在預設取樣設定下套用；Bedrock推出可能延遲數日。
items_flat.analysis_en: The expansion advances EU AI Act Article 50 compliance, yet the default-parameter restriction on two widely used models creates a practical bypass that weakens the guarantee for many production workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此擴展推進歐盟AI法案第50條合規，但兩個廣泛使用模型的預設參數限制造成實務繞過，削弱許多生產工作負載的保證。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens applications for paid Residency aimed at senior technical leaders
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開放針對資深技術領導者的付費駐留計畫申請
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced on November 2 that applications are open for its paid Residency (placements of six weeks to six months). The program targets professors in quantitative fields, technical founders, and staff-level engineers; no machine learning background is required.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月2日宣布開放付費駐留計畫申請（六週至六個月）。計畫針對量化領域教授、技術創辦人與資深工程師；不要求機器學習背景。
items_flat.analysis_en: Recruiting established quantitative talent without requiring prior ML experience is a practical response to the scarcity of experienced AI safety researchers. Success depends on how well the program converts short residencies into lasting contributions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 招募已建立的量化人才且不要求先前ML經驗，是對資深AI安全研究員稀缺的務實回應。成功取決於計畫如何將短期駐留轉化為持久貢獻。
items_flat.quote: Today we are opening applications for the Anthropic Residency, our paid, fixed-term research program with placements lasting between six weeks and six months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們開放 Anthropic Residency 申請，這是一個付費、固定期限的研究計畫，時長介於六週至六個月。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI raises bug bounty rewards (up to $172k) and plans next internal security sprint
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI提高漏洞賞金（最高17.2萬美元）並規劃下次內部安全衝刺
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 2 that it is more than quadrupling average midpoints for medium/high/critical bug bounty rewards, with exceptional critical findings eligible for up to $172,000 including bonuses, and that past-30-day awards can be reconsidered. It is also planning the next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems researchers using its models.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日宣布將中高危漏洞賞金平均中點提高逾四倍，卓越嚴重發現（含獎金）最高可達17.2萬美元，且過去30天獎項可重新考慮。同時規劃與Cathedral Systems研究人員合作的下次內部安全衝刺，使用其模型測試防禦。
items_flat.analysis_en: Higher external incentives plus internal AI-assisted red-teaming reflect growing recognition that model capabilities are outpacing traditional defenses. The real test is whether the higher payouts and sprints produce durable reductions in residual risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更高外部激勵加上內部AI輔助紅隊，反映模型能力超越傳統防禦的認識加深。真正考驗是更高獎金與衝刺能否持久降低殘餘風險。
items_flat.quote: As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著 AI 在尋找漏洞方面變得更強，防禦方需要在攻擊者之前加以運用。

anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team published on November 2 and highlighted on X on November 3 FlashProve, an open-source zkSNARK prototype that lets a provider commit to model weights and prove a response came from that model without revealing the weights. On Llama 4 Maverick (400B, 4-bit) a single H100 generates proofs at ~110 tokens/s with ~19 MB proofs per 1,024-token request.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊於11月2日發布、並於11月3日在X上強調FlashProve，這是開源zkSNARK原型，讓供應商承諾模型權重並證明回應來自該模型而不揭露權重。在Llama 4 Maverick（400B、4-bit）上，單一H100以約110 tokens/秒產生證明，每1,024 token請求約19 MB。
anthropic.analysis_en: Provable inference addresses real trust gaps in routing, evaluation and server compromise, but the 70–95× proving overhead versus vLLM keeps it a research prototype rather than a production feature today.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 可證明推論解決路由、評估與伺服器遭入侵等真實信任落差，但相較vLLM約70–95倍的證明開銷，使其目前仍屬研究原型而非生產功能。
anthropic.quote: Today, we release FlashProve: an open-source performant prototype for provable inference.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天，我們發布FlashProve：一個開源、高效能的可證明推論原型。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic expands invisible text watermark to Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic將隱形文字浮水印擴展至Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6
anthropic.summary_en: Effective November 3, text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s invisible text watermark (an imperceptible pattern in word choice). On Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 the mark applies only at default sampling settings; Bedrock rollout may lag a few days.
anthropic.summary_zh: 自11月3日起，Claude Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6產生的文字將帶有Anthropic的隱形文字浮水印（詞彙選擇中的不可察覺模式）。在Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6上，僅在預設取樣設定下套用；Bedrock推出可能延遲數日。
anthropic.analysis_en: The expansion advances EU AI Act Article 50 compliance, yet the default-parameter restriction on two widely used models creates a practical bypass that weakens the guarantee for many production workloads.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此擴展推進歐盟AI法案第50條合規，但兩個廣泛使用模型的預設參數限制造成實務繞過，削弱許多生產工作負載的保證。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens applications for paid Residency aimed at senior technical leaders
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic開放針對資深技術領導者的付費駐留計畫申請
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic announced on November 2 that applications are open for its paid Residency (placements of six weeks to six months). The program targets professors in quantitative fields, technical founders, and staff-level engineers; no machine learning background is required.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月2日宣布開放付費駐留計畫申請（六週至六個月）。計畫針對量化領域教授、技術創辦人與資深工程師；不要求機器學習背景。
anthropic.analysis_en: Recruiting established quantitative talent without requiring prior ML experience is a practical response to the scarcity of experienced AI safety researchers. Success depends on how well the program converts short residencies into lasting contributions.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 招募已建立的量化人才且不要求先前ML經驗，是對資深AI安全研究員稀缺的務實回應。成功取決於計畫如何將短期駐留轉化為持久貢獻。
anthropic.quote: Today we are opening applications for the Anthropic Residency, our paid, fixed-term research program with placements lasting between six weeks and six months.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天我們開放 Anthropic Residency 申請，這是一個付費、固定期限的研究計畫，時長介於六週至六個月。

google.title_en: Google releases Physical-Engineering’s Last Exam (PLE) agent benchmark and open competition
google.title_zh: Google發布實體工程最終考試（PLE）代理基準與公開競賽
google.summary_en: On November 3 Google AI & Infrastructure announced PLE, an 85-task benchmark of long-horizon mechanical, electrical, civil and structural engineering work developed with Mercor. It released 29 public tasks, graders and a leaderboard; on the private set the best model (Claude Opus 5.5) scored 48.3%, with all frontier models below 50%.
google.summary_zh: 11月3日Google AI與基礎設施團隊宣布PLE，這是與Mercor合作開發的85項長期機械、電機、土木與結構工程任務基準。釋出29項公開任務、評分工具與排行榜；私有測試集上最佳模型（Claude Opus 5.5）得分48.3%，所有前沿模型皆低於50%。
google.analysis_en: PLE exposes a clear gap between strong coding-agent scores and the ability to produce fully code-compliant, cost-aware physical designs. Hard safety gates mean partial correctness rarely earns full credit.
google.analysis_zh: PLE揭示強大編碼代理分數與產出完全符合法規、考量成本的實體設計能力之間的明顯落差。嚴格安全關卡使部分正確很少獲得完整分數。
google.quote: Today, the Google AI & Infrastructure team is announcing Physical-Engineering's Last Exam (PLE), a new benchmark and open competition.
google.quote_zh: 今天，Google AI與基礎設施團隊宣布實體工程最終考試（PLE），一項新的基準與公開競賽。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1T-parameter Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral釋出1T參數Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開放權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a roughly 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model, on October 29 under a modified MIT-style license. After additional reinforcement learning it leads open models on coding-agent and cyber benchmarks while using substantially fewer tokens than comparables.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral於10月29日釋出改良版Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開放權重，這是約1兆參數的原生多模態混合專家模型，採修改版MIT式授權。經額外強化學習後，在編碼代理與網路安全基準上領先開放模型，且使用的token明顯少於同類。
frontier_other.analysis_en: A European lab shipping a trillion-parameter open-weight model with strong coding and cyber results lowers the barrier for sovereign or on-premise frontier-class agents. Token efficiency remains the practical differentiator versus closed alternatives.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 歐洲實驗室推出具強編碼與網路安全表現的兆參數開放權重模型，降低主權或本地部署前沿級代理的門檻。相較封閉替代方案，token效率仍是實際差異點。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出這個改進版 Mistral Large 4 的權重。

brief_en: Labs push AI into physical engineering: OpenAI shows ChatGPT/Codex speeding CAD and hardware design with partners; Google opens PLE, an 85-task agent benchmark where top models score under 50%. Anthropic releases FlashProve for cryptographic proof of which model produced a response, and extends text watermarking.
brief_zh: 大廠將AI推進實體工程：OpenAI展示ChatGPT與Codex加速CAD與硬體設計；Google開放PLE基準，頂尖模型得分低於50%。Anthropic發布FlashProve以加密證明模型身份，並擴大文字浮水印。
